observation.policy: Amounts are integer cents. Count gross revenue from paid orders in the requested month, region and segment. Subtract refunds occurring in that month for paid orders of the same region and segment, even when the original order is from another month. Exclude cancelled orders and their refunds. Net revenue = eligible gross - eligible refunds. Change = current net - prior net. Policy ID: revenue-v1.
